heading: We don't cut corners.
description: We set out to build a brand you can trust, all the way through. From our farmers to our ingredients, to our packaging, we are intentional in making sure sustainability and ethics lie at the core of what we do.

cards.title: Direct Trade
cards.text: Farmers paid 3x market rate with no middleman. Our 98% farmer retention rate ensures that the hands harvesting our Fonio are respected.

cards.title: Sustainability
cards.text: 14,200 acres regenerated using drought-resistant crops. We choose to live in harmony with the earth rather than extraction.

cards.title: Nourishment
cards.text: Pure, nutrient-dense ingredients with nothing added. Every grain carries sunlight converted to sustenance.
